Confidence.description:
How much to trust the state beside it.

Never presented without the claim it qualifies. With thirty nodes reporting,
the system says so; it does not quietly present the same number it would give
for four hundred.

stability.description: agreement with recent estimates for this zone
stability.title: Stability

reportable.description: The contract's served judgement; clients never restate its thresholds.
reportable.title: Reportable

Confidence.title: Confidence

LOSBand.description: Operational density band. Always rendered with its word and its number.
LOSBand.title: LOSBand

density_persons_m2.description: persons per square metre — the AUTHORITATIVE measure. Flow is not monotonic in density (it peaks then collapses), so a band cannot be read off flow alone: a jammed corridor and an empty one look alike.
density_persons_m2.title: Density Persons M2

flow_ped_m_min.description: pedestrians per metre width per minute — reported, not classified on
flow_ped_m_min.title: Flow Ped M Min

queue_excess.description: people who do not fit at jam density, i.e. backed up behind
queue_excess.title: Queue Excess

estimated_population.description:
Observed devices scaled by measured participation.

The single most load-bearing number in the system, which is why
participation_rate is measured rather than configured.
estimated_population.title: Estimated Population

band.description:
Operational band, classified on density (see standards.band_for_density).

CRITICAL means at or beyond capacity density — the point where flow stops
improving and starts to collapse — not a high flow number.

over_capacity.description:
Past the peak of the fundamental diagram: more arrivals now reduce
throughput. The single most important operator signal.
over_capacity.title: Over Capacity

los_grade.description: Full Fruin grade A-F. Console only; the app never shows this.
los_grade.title: Los Grade

net_flow_per_min.description: Positive means filling. Sustained positive net flow is the early warning.
net_flow_per_min.title: Net Flow Per Min

description: Every zone at one tick, plus what the system knows it cannot see.

unobserved_zones.description: Zones with no reporting device. MUST render as unknown, never as empty. Under D7 uplinks are opportunistic, so coverage genuinely varies.
unobserved_zones.title: Unobserved Zones
